# Attachments

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Manage file attachments on Jira issues.

## jira attachment list

List attachments on an issue.

**Aliases:** `jira issue attachment list`, `ls`

### Usage

```
jira attachment list <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |

### Examples

```bash
jira attachment list MYPROJ-42
jira attachment list MYPROJ-42 --json
```

---

## jira attachment upload

Upload one or more files as attachments to an issue.

**Alias:** `jira issue attachment upload`

### Usage

```
jira attachment upload <issue-key> <file>... [flags]
```

### Examples

```bash
jira attachment upload MYPROJ-42 screenshot.png
jira attachment upload MYPROJ-42 screenshot.png logs.txt report.pdf
```

---

## jira attachment download

Download attachments from an issue.

**Alias:** `jira issue attachment download`

### Usage

```
jira attachment download <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--all` | | Download all attachments |
| `--name` | | Download by filename |
| `--dest` | | Destination directory (default: current directory) |

### Examples

```bash
jira attachment download MYPROJ-42 --all
jira attachment download MYPROJ-42 --name screenshot.png --dest ~/Downloads
```

---

## jira attachment delete

Delete an attachment from an issue.

**Alias:** `jira issue attachment delete`

### Usage

```
jira attachment delete <issue-key> <attachment-id-or-name> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | | Skip confirmation prompt |

### Examples

```bash
jira attachment delete MYPROJ-42 10001
jira attachment delete MYPROJ-42 old-screenshot.png --confirm
```
